note: Shared connection-type library (keeper: A4 since D-46; was agent 2). Few fastener sizes on purpose: M2, M3 (M4/M6 only where a bought part sets it). A type used by one subsystem only stays in that subsystem's interfaces.json; a type here may also be declared locally, but then it must be identical; where an owner declared a type first, the library carries the owner's text verbatim (pod, propulsion, transport, A4-R3). "structural": false marks a type that locates a part but never carries its flight load (ties, wire channels, labels, pneumatic tubing): merge_check.py does not count it as a load path. Connector ratings: redesign/inputs/DECISIONS-ADOPTED.md and team/F1/POWER.md.
